svg.title: Swinging Lexical Network, animated
svg.desc: Two trials in turn. Target t (yellow) appears, then distractor d (blue), then activation spreads over the cohort's neighbours. When it is spread thinly (high entropy), no word stands out, there is a single competitor and naming is facilitated; when it pools on a few words (low entropy), those words are the competitors (green) and naming shows interference.
